Interface ThrowInstruction

All Superinterfaces:
ClassFileElementPREVIEW, CodeElementPREVIEW, InstructionPREVIEW
public sealed interface ThrowInstruction extends InstructionPREVIEW
ThrowInstruction is a preview API of the Java platform.
Programs can only use ThrowInstruction when preview features are enabled.
Preview features may be removed in a future release, or upgraded to permanent features of the Java platform.
Models an athrow instruction in the code array of a Code attribute. Delivered as a CodeElementPREVIEW when traversing the elements of a CodeModelPREVIEW.
